item.title: IndiGo gets more time to reply to DGCA notice as disruptions persist
item.description: DGCA has granted IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers more time to respond to its show-cause notice over massive flight disruptions. The airline must submit its reply by 6 pm on Monday after seeking an extension.

item.title: Hamas and Israel edge towards second phase of US-backed Gaza deal
item.description: As Israel and Hamas prepare to move towards the second stage of a United States-led blueprint intended to bring an end to Israel’s war on Gaza, disputes are emerging over the proposed role of an international stabilisation force in the enclave.

item.description: AICC chief Mallikarjun Kharge has wished success to the Telangana government’s two-day ‘Telangana Rising Global Summit’, saying he hopes the event will push forward the state’s long-term development vision.

item.title: ECI weighs appointment of micro observers for Bengal electoral roll revision
item.description: ECI is weighing the use of micro observers for the second phase of the Special Intensive Revision of West Bengal’s electoral roll. The next stage begins after the draft roll is published on 16 December.
